dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: A chat? Is there some commercial matter you wish to inquire about?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Hmm, interesting... so many merchants and business magnates, vying to invite me to dinner.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: And you wish to have a "simple chat"?

choices.text: I don't think I could afford the dinners they're buying.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Haha... Ahh, you make me laugh.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: These people... they send me the most extravagant gifts...

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: ...But all they're really after are my words... any morsel of information that may hint at Liyue's future commercial trends.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Which makes the prospect of a carefree, honest chat here with you... all the more valuable to me.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: For it is something that Mora cannot buy.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: So, stay with me a while, and let's chat about the simpler things in life. Anything at all.

choices.text: We can talk about anything you like.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: ...You really are quite different from the rest.
